message.content:
I’m happy to help! To give you an accurate fare estimate for a business‑class ticket from ORD to SVP on July 14, 2026, I’ll need to check the current pricing and availability. Since the system doesn’t expose a “price‑only” query, the usual way to see the exact cost is to run a quick booking simulation—this will let us pull the latest rates without actually reserving the seat.

Could you share the ID of a credit card you’d like to use for this estimate? If you don’t have one registered yet, I can walk you through adding a new card so we can proceed. Once I have the card ID, I’ll fetch the nearest airports for ORD and SVP (just to double‑check the IATA codes), then perform a provisional booking to reveal the business‑class price for your requested date.
